book.name: Aroma
book.title: AROMA KINA'MI NKISA PORO KAENTIYE AROMA

content: Taeba Karaisiti ntapiyena aegarano
We, monota esegiyenarentaga kina'mitaba anu kina igama iyo'maema kuntaenawaipa aesagabeno. Taete ntapiyenaba a-nkaegarano.
Taeba taokina'mi igeka napimagi, aogimagi, monota esegi pikibeka iyo'maeyano.
We, Karaisiti aeba ae'wa ntapiyenaba kampa aegaraye. Pika mono isa'amaba ae awamutasa kamana maya iye: We, Koti, iyekita pugata kina'miba iyekitaenawaipa naeti aborantine, piya untiye, iye.
Pigoya, pai mono kamana uma kaentapa, pipa taeka ago abibebe piyoma kaemarantane. Pi kamana'ama nkagoba esegi puratamika taeba paebuma mima Koti taba pukibitaka aobi puma mikune.
We, Koti aeba asiratama esegi puratakena agowe. Aeba Karaisiti Isuti atokaema tiyo'mige kaga mikenaga tiyo'maeyano.
Piyama tiyo'maeyagiri, tigeba ka tiwamu'ena puma, Wa'egare Isu Karaisiti nkabawampa, Koti, ae age asagayuyiyo.
Karaisitiba Yuta kinape to marisa kinape kaga tao'maentiye
Karaisiti aeba agu kao'ena puma tiba puntisa puma, pabiyama tiyo'mipa ibabiyo. Piya pukibepa, Koti nkageba asagayukibewe.
Naeba mayaga yuwe: Koti aeba tayabamagipa ka'isa kamana utawaitantiye. Pi kamana'ama nkau'wa aborakenaga Karaisiti aeba tumpa i kasanta kina'miti aborama kayokaya'ena puntiye.
Ibintogaba kampa tumintine. To marisa kina'miba igegeba Koti nkantara'enawapa agama ae age asagayuyiyema tumintiye. Pika mono isa'ama maya iye:

content.text: Naeba to marisa kina'mi nkikapi kamanakapa aborama, inibisaba kagega'eba asagayukuwe, piya untiye, iye.

content: Pigoya, mono isa'ama to ka maya iye:

content.text: To marisa kina, tigeba Koti nkaokina'mige ti'mu piyo, untiye. iye.

content: Pigoya, to kapa maya iye:

content.text: A'ya'ma to marisa kina'mitaba, Wa'egawama nkagega'eba asagayuyiyo, iye.
Piya, a'ya'ma toma toma kina'miba age asagayuyeno, piya untiye, iye.

content: Pigoya, to ka kamana Aisaya mayama kaentiye:

content.text: Tayabama Yesinta aubutasa asaewaba pakiye, iye.
Pi ntagaramaba asima mima to marisa kina'mita kabiwaitakiye, iye.
Piya pekini, to marisa kina'miba aeti uma atokaema i'mu pukibewe, iyema kaentiye.

content: Pigoya, Koti aeba tamatiti'enarempa nkagoba mintiye. Aeba timatiti'enarika ti'muntanabe paruyenabe tabera aborama timekiri, Aota Awamusa'ama nkesegiyenabi mima, aeti atokaekenaga aobi pigina, Kotiba pintanaba pumaeritano.
Poroba a'muntanabisa mono yugaba puntiye

We, nao'nempitaba, tigeka ago abibebe pogana kanarasaye. Piya, tigeti aogiyenaba pumae waintegiri, tigeba mono agoba kanara abibebe puma, ankao'mae ao'mae pumagiri aogi napiyena tiyo'mipa imikena pewe.
Pigoya, Koti awagaena namintika, naeba naekuru kampa punta, tigegu'a pusanaga ka'isa kamanapa esegima tigeti kaeyuwe.

Piya, to marisa kina'miti Isu Karaisiti mpono kayokaya yagara mima Koti nkaogi kamana uwaimoma unatantika, Koti awagaenaba namintiye. Pipa namoga, aeti muta atama to marisa kina ibabute kanakena puwe. Piya pekana, Aota Awamusa'ama aota puwaitakana Kotiba a'mu puwaitanema, yuwe.
Naeba Karaisiti Isuti atokaema mima Koti ntuga poka, kanara tabera Kotiti na'mu potauwe.

We, Karaisiti esegiyena namoga puwagana au'wapa aboranti, pika yuwe. Tonagaba kampa ukuwe. Piya, ae esegiyenarasa to marisa kina'miba iyakuwagini, mono kamanapa wasintane. Nawamutasabe nayatasabe yoga pumagi,

awame'enabe kasa'enabe aboramagi, Aota Awamusa'amatisa esegiyena mae u'ma, to marisa kina'mi mono abima wasiyiyema, yogaba puntone. Yerusaremi kumatasa agobima Karaisiti nkaogi mono'wapa uwaimirite wama Iririkamu mari uma irosantone.
Piya, naeba to kina'mi kimaranta abobora kisanagaba kampa nabuntine. Karaisiti nkage awaga kamana kampa uma irosanti kina'miti wama mono kamana uwaimikena puntone.
Pika mono isa'ama maya iye:

content.text: Ae kampa aganta'nagiba agowapa agakibewe, iye.
Aeka kampa abinta'nagiba agowapa abikibewe, iye.

content: Pi nkawameta uwaimintone.
Poro aeba Aroma kinapa igasanaga abuntiye
Pigoya, pi mono uwaimikena yugaba uwoma waiyegini, uwaena yaga tigeti ikenaba pi ntugama ke'nepa akuntatantiye.
We, uwoma kabuba tigeti wama tigasanaga nabuntine. Pigoya, mapa ka'isa mariba yoganepa a'ya pemika,
Sipeni mari wakena punta tigetiba uma irosakuwe. Uma irosa'ma, ka'isa yaga tigege umiyekana nantawamaba asoya pekiri, nao'maeyigi naeba Sipeni mari kaga wakuwe.
Pigoya, ma kanabipa Yerusaremi kumati ima, Kotiti atokaenta kina'mintana iyo'maekenaena maete iyuwe.
Piya, Masetoniya kina'mibe Akaiya kina'mibe intawama aseyonabisa mone aki puma, Yerusaremi kumatasa Kotiti atokaenta kina kusi kina'minta, ige'ena aki potaga, maete iyuwe.

Piya, igeba inta aseyonawaika piya pegana kanarasaye. Eya, to marisa kina igeba Yuta kina'mitisa taga mpono kaga abintaka, iretaba igetiba waintiye. Pi ireta imeka kotankaitasa iyo'maeyagana kanarasaye.
Pigoya, pi kana iretawama nkau'wapa maete ima, mesu imekana a'ya pekapa, tigeti wama tigata, Sipeni mari wakuwe.
We, naeba abintuwe: Tigeti kanakubopa, Karaisiti nka'muntanaba pumaema wainatantaka, ima tigeti asu aborakuwe.
We, nao'mitaba, tigeba Wa'egare Isu Karaisitigabe, Awamusa'ama nkagu kao'enawakabe napima, naekega kaga Kotiti nunamu esegima yigina nao'maeyano.

Nunamu yigini, Yutiya mari mima kamana kampa aegara kina'mi nkiyapisa Kotiba akaruyoba'natano. Piya, tigeba nunamu yigini, to marisa kina'mi intawama aseyonabisa mone aki potaigi, pipa Yerusaremi kumatasa Kotiti atokaenta kina me imekanaba iga ibeno.
Piya pigi, ainti Koti abemika, naeba na'muntanabisa tigeti ima migarakana paru nabeno.
Pigoya Koti, paruyena agowamaba, aeba a'ya'ma tigege miwaeyano. Tagane.
